name: Apple Music
author: Homin Luo
description: Native Apple Music for the Omarchy shell: browse the catalogue and your library, decrypt Widevine locally, and play 256 kbps AAC through mpv. A now-playing dropdown in the bar, a full window, no Electron or browser at runtime.

barWidget.description: Now-playing dropdown with seek, transport, volume and Up Next. Right-click the icon for the full window: Home, Browse, Search, your library and the queue.

schema.label: Show the track title in the bar
Bar title width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Longer titles scroll; 0 hides the title and leaves the icon.
